description: Extract timed subtitle segments (offset_ms, duration_ms) and complete plain-text transcript for any YouTube video or Short. Supports auto-generated and manual caption tracks in all languages.

lang.description: Preferred 2-letter subtitle language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de, ja). Defaults to en.

video_id.description: 11-character YouTube video ID or full youtube.com/watch?v=... / youtu.be/... URL

name: youtube_transcript
